Title: Valid login with standard user
Steps: Enter username; enter password; click Login
Expected Result: User is logged in and products page is shown

Title: Login with locked-out user
Steps: Enter username; enter password; click Login
Expected Result: Error shown: user has been locked out

Title: Login with wrong password
Steps: Enter username; enter wrong password; click Login
Expected Result: Error: username and password do not match

Title: Login with unknown username
Steps: Enter unknown username; enter password; click Login
Expected Result: Error: username and password do not match

Title: Login with empty username
Steps: Leave username blank; enter password; click Login

Title: Login with empty password
Steps: Enter username; leave password blank; click Login

Title: Login with both fields empty
Steps: Leave both blank; click Login

Title: Password field is masked
Steps: Type into the password field and observe

Title: Six products are listed after login
Steps: Open products page and count items

Title: Sort products Name A to Z
Steps: Select sort = Name (A to Z)

Title: Sort products Name Z to A
Steps: Select sort = Name (Z to A)

Title: Sort products Price low to high
Steps: Select sort = Price (low to high)

Title: Sort products Price high to low
Steps: Select sort = Price (high to low)

Title: Add one product to cart
Steps: Click Add to cart on one product
Expected Result: Cart badge shows 1 and button changes to Remove

Title: Remove product from cart on products page
Steps: Click Remove on that product
Expected Result: Cart badge decreases; button returns to Add to cart

Title: Cart shows the added item
Steps: Open the cart
Expected Result: The cart lists the correct item with its price

Title: Cart quantity is 1 by default
Steps: Open the cart and read quantity

Title: Continue shopping returns to products
Steps: Click Continue Shopping

Title: Start checkout with an item
Steps: Open cart and click Checkout
Expected Result: Checkout step one (your information) is shown

Title: Checkout with empty first name
Steps: Leave first name blank; fill others; Continue

Title: Checkout with empty postal code
Steps: Fill names; leave postal code blank; Continue

Title: Checkout with valid single-char postal code
Steps: Fill names; postal code = 1; Continue

Title: Checkout with long postal code
Steps: Fill names; postal code = 20 chars; Continue

Title: Complete a valid order
Preconditions: Item in cart; valid info entered
Steps: Continue to overview; click Finish
Expected Result: Order confirmation Thank you for your order is shown

Title: Order summary shows correct total
Steps: Read item total and total
Expected Result: Total equals item price plus tax

Title: Log out from the menu
Steps: Open the menu and click Logout
Expected Result: User is returned to the login page

Title: Performance_glitch_user login is slow
Steps: Login and time how long the products page takes

Title: Product image is correct for each item
Steps: Compare each product image to its name
Expected Result: Each image matches its product (known defect user may break this)
